lvl_01.title: Well, that's ODD
lvl_01.problem:
Create a machine that, given in input a sequence of numbers, increments by 1 every EVEN digit.

For example, if your input is this:
_____16334087_____
Then your output should be this:
_____17335197_____

(HINT: Remember that the number 0 is EVEN)

lvl_02.title: [Counting inTENsifies]
lvl_02.problem:
Create a machine that, given a number, outputs the same number multiplied by TEN.

(HINT: Underscores can be overwritten)

EXAMPLE:
__123__->__1230_

lvl_03.title: There can be only ONE
lvl_03.problem:
Scan the input, and delete every 1 except the first.

(HINT: To delete a character, overwrite it with an underscore)

EXAMPLE:
__01213__->__012_3__

lvl_04.title: NICEn't
lvl_04.problem:
The President is sick of all the immature jokes on the Internet, and decided to ban the number 69.
Your task is to create a machine that scans the input, and replaces every occurrence of the forbidden number with its politically correct neighbour, the number 68.

EXAMPLES:
__24699__->__24689__
__69669__->__68668__

lvl_05.title: Hide and seek
lvl_05.problem:
Delete all the x's that are not hiding inside of parentheses.

EXAMPLES:
__x(xx)xx__->__(xx)__
_(x)x(x)_->_(x)_(x)_

lvl_06.title: Let's call it EVEN
lvl_06.problem:
In this level you will only need the numbers 0 and 1.

Count the 1's in the input and determine if their total number is even or ODD.
If it's ODD, append another 1 at the end of the input, so that the total number of 1's becomes even.
Do not overwrite the 0's.

EXAMPLE:
__0100__->__01001_
__0110__->__0110__

lvl_07.title: The magic number
lvl_07.problem:
Write 1 if the input number is divisible by 3, or 0 otherwise.

Remember to delete the original number, leave only the 0 or the 1.

(HINT: A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3. If you're stuck, look at the previous level for inspiration.)

EXAMPLES:
__123__->__1__
__301__->__0__

lvl_08.title: Survival of the largest
lvl_08.problem:
Scan the input, and output the largest digit you find.

To make things easier, the input will contain only digits 1 through 5.

EXAMPLES:
__114223__->__4__
__355252__->__5__

lvl_09.title: Last ONE standing
lvl_09.problem:
Delete every 1 except the last.

(HINT: It's like level 3, but moving backwards)

lvl_10.title: The other magic number
lvl_10.problem:
Write 1 if the input number is divisible by 100, or 0 otherwise.

Remember to delete the original number, leave only the 0 or the 1.

EXAMPLES:
__123__->__0__
__4200__->__1__

lvl_11.problem:
Increment the input number by 1.

EXAMPLE:
__23__->__24__
__39__->__40__

lvl_12.title: The league of the N evil exes
lvl_12.problem:
You will receive in input a number N (one digit, between 0 and 9).

Write in output the letter X exactly N times, and delete the initial number.

EXAMPLE:
__5__->__XXXXX__

lvl_13.title: Clash of numbers
lvl_13.problem:
The input will contain two digits. Write the difference between the two digits (without sign).

(HINT: There are two methods to solve this problem: you can calculate the difference directly, or you can decrement both digits one by one until one of them reaches 0. I recommend the second approach.)

EXAMPLES:
__53__->__2__
__18__->__7__

lvl_14.title: It all adds up
lvl_14.problem:
The input will contain two numbers separated by an underscore. Your output should contain the sum of the two numbers.

EXAMPLES:
__15_9__->__24__
__41_182__->__223__

lvl_15.title: Make it COUNT
lvl_15.problem:
Write (in numbers) how many times the letter X is repeated in the input tape.

Remember to delete the X's as you count them: the final output must contain only the number.

EXAMPLE:
__XXX__->__3__

(HINT: While running a test, increase the speed using the + button)

lvl_16.title: Repetita iuvant
lvl_16.problem:
You will receive in input a number N (just like two levels ago, but this time N will be greater than 10).

Write in output the letter X exactly N times, and delete the initial number.

lvl_17.title: Double trouble
lvl_17.problem:
You just hacked in your bank account! Use a Turing Machine to double your amount of $.

EXAMPLE:
__$$$__->__$$$$$$__

lvl_18.title: Sp_lit
lvl_18.problem:
The input will contain a sequence of 1s and 0s. Whenever you find a group of two or more 1s close together, separate them by inserting a 0 between them.

Note: when inserting the 0, do not replace the 1, but shift it (and all the following digits) to the right.

EXAMPLES:
__110__->__1010__
__111__->__10101__

lvl_19.title: Sort it out
lvl_19.problem:
Oh no! An earthquake messed up your collection of number-shaped fridge magnets, and now they're all scrambled on the floor in random order.

Can you put them back in their place? First the 1's on the left, then the 2's in the middle, and finally the 3's on the right.

Make sure you don't add or remove any magnet to your collection, they're all numbered! (hehe)

(HINT: If you're stuck, look up "bubble sort" on your preferred search engine)

EXAMPLE:
__121313123__->__111122333__

lvl_20.title: Is this Lisp?
lvl_20.problem:
The input will contain a sequence of ( and ). Write ( if the parentheses are properly matched, ) otherwise.

For your convenience, in this level you can also use [ and ] as "helper" symbols.

EXAMPLES:
__())__->__)__
__(())__->__(__
__()()__->__(__
__)()__->__)__

lvl_21.title: Among us
lvl_21.problem:
Captain! The Impostors have infiltrated our spaceship, we must find them before they can sabotage the crewmembers.

The numbers 0 and 1 represent crewmembers, while the impostors are represented by the number 2.

Eliminate the impostors, without changing the number and the order of crewmates, and without leaving gaps between them.

EXAMPLE:
__01200__->__0100__
(NOT __01_00__)

lvl_22.title: It's a match!
lvl_22.problem:
The input will contain two sequences of 1s and 0s, separated by an underscore. Write 1 if they are equal, or 0 if they aren't.

EXAMPLES:
__10_10__->__1__
__10_01__->__0__
__101_1__->__0__

lvl_23.title: Apples to oranges
lvl_23.problem:
You are a contestant in a game show on TV. The host shows you two boxes: the one on the left is full of apples, the one on the right contains oranges. Can you guess which box contains more fruits?

Your input will look like this:
__[AA]_[OOO]__
Each pair of brackets represents a box, each A represents an apple, and each O represents an orange.

Overwrite the underscore between the two boxes with the symbol > if there are more apples, < if there are more oranges, or = if they are equal.

Do not overwrite the letters or the brackets. The output should look like this:
__[AA]<[OOO]__

lvl_24.title: esreveR
lvl_24.problem:
The input will contain a sequence of digits. Write to output its reverse.

To make things easier, the input will contain only digits 1 through 5.

EXAMPLES:
__42__->__24__
__311__->__113__

lvl_25.title: Majority vote
lvl_25.problem:
You just received a call from the President's office. He was very satisfied with the work you did for him in level 4, and he decided to give you another job: write the software that will count the votes in the upcoming election.

You will receive in input a list of 0's and 1's. Each 0 represents a vote for the re-election of the current president, and each 1 represents a vote for the other candidate.
You must count the votes, and declare the winner: write in the output a single 1 or 0, depending on who obtained the majority. In the case of a tie, the rules say that the current president gets re-elected anyway, so write a 0.

EXAMPLE:
__1100011101__->__1__
